name: headingLevel
description: Heading level, 2 to 6. Defaults to 2. Set it so the card does not skip a level in the page's heading order.

name: headerColour
description: Renders the heading in a coloured band. `green` (the Defra brand green) is the only supported value — it is the role the branding guidance sanctions for that colour. The banded title is white and its size and weight are pinned, because white on this green (3.33:1) conforms only under the large-text threshold.

name: href
description: Makes the heading a link. If `actions` is not set, the whole card becomes clickable.

name: meta
description: Short supporting line above the description, such as a reference or a date.

name: actions
description: Footer links. Setting this disables whole-card clicking, because an overlay would make these unreachable.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: Appended for screen readers, so repeated actions are distinguishable out of context.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the card.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the card.
